prompt: Our editorial team needs a daily technology news digest for internal review. We have a curated RSS subscription list saved at `feeds/opml/tech_feeds.opml` in our workspace. Please generate a categorized Chinese-language technology brief covering the last 24 hours from this feed list, and save the result to a file named `daily_brief.md`. The brief should include between 5 and 10 articles, grouped by topic category, each with a concise Chinese summary. Make sure it uses no more than 10 concurrent workers and is limited to fetching a maximum of 200 feeds.
